productPrice.description: The price of the selected product.

deliveryTime.description: Estimated delivery time for the product or service.

deliveryType.description: Human-readable delivery flag such as Digital, Physical, or Service.

canvasSize.description: Only applies to posters or prints. Example: 8x11 in.

resolution.description: Only applies to wallpapers. Example: 720p, HD, 2K, 4K.

commissionType.description: Only applies to commissions. Example: Album Cover or Poster.

units.description: The amount of items in stock for that product.

inStockFlag.description: Flags the item as in stock, low stock, or out of stock.

description.description: The product description or backstory behind the piece.

category.description: The category the product is in, such as Posters or Typefaces.

collection.description: The collection the product belongs to, such as Music or Y2K.

type.description: The specific product type, such as Poster, Desktop Wallpaper, or Display Typeface.

example.description: A stylized display font with elevated contrast and bold personality.
